# Personal wallets

A Verana-integrated wallet answers three questions for its user: is this service trusted and who operates it, may it issue this credential, may it ask for this credential. The normative integration guideline and the conformance test live in [verana-spec](https://github.com/verana-labs/verana-spec/tree/main/playground); these pages summarise them and point to the calls.

1. [Integrate Verana in a personal wallet](./00-integrate.md)
2. [The calls your wallet makes](./10-calls.md)
3. [Render the Proof-of-Trust](./20-proof-of-trust.md)
4. [Test and get listed](./30-test-and-get-listed.md)

Six wallets are listed today on the [playground](https://playground.testnet.verana.network/personal-wallets).
